description: This source file defines the EmployeeSkillAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing employee skills within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee skill records, along with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing employee skills, including CRUD operations and listing with filtering and sorting capabilities. Implements validation and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee skill by employee number and skill ID, returning the skill details or throwing a not found exception.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all skills associated with a specific employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee skill record based on provided parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee skill based on input parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified employee skills for a given employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Handles the creation or updating of an EmployeeSkill entity from request parameters.
